cases.request_text: Plan a neutral-singlet ORCA frequency project preserving B3LYP-D3BJ/ma-def2-TZVP exactly.
Plan a Gaussian B3LYP/pcseg-2 frequency project. Distinguish BSE discovery from deterministic compiler materialization.
Plan an ORCA B3LYP/aug-mcc-pV8Z optimization without treating BSE name discovery as native/compiler readiness.
The source says def2-TZVXP. Search conservatively, preserve the reported spelling, and do not select a fuzzy candidate.
Plan B3LYP/def2-TZVP for a Cl/Fe system and report whether the pinned BSE definition embeds an Fe ECP.
Plan B3LYP/def2-TZVP for a Cl/Pd system and report the exact pinned BSE Pd ECP electron count.
Assess B3LYP/def2-TZVPPD for Pd and Ce. Block if the pinned basis definition lacks either element.
Assess def2-ECP as the only reported Pd basis. Reject an ECP-only definition that has no orbital functions.
Plan a GFN-FF xTB optimization with ALPB n-hexane. Preserve the hyphenated solvent identity and do not invent an orbital basis.
Plan an ORCA B97M-D4/def2-SVP frequency project. Preserve B97M-D4 as one exact checked compound functional.
Assess Gaussian B3LYP with a separate D4 correction and def2-SVP. Do not silently drop D4.
Assess ORCA B3LYP-D3ZERO/def2-SVP. Do not reduce the compound string to plain B3LYP or claim it is compiler ready.
Assess the reported functional text `B3LYP nosymm` with def2-SVP. Reject native route content in a typed functional.
The source incorrectly associates def2-SVP with GFN2-xTB. Represent the conflict and block; do not invent basis semantics.
